Annual GST Summary

Source: R/collection.R
gst_annual_summary.Rd

Aggregate monthly state-wise data to annual totals by state, region, or nationally.

gst_annual_summary(
  by = c("state", "region", "national"),
  component = .COMP_COLS,
  financial_year = NULL,
  exclude_other = TRUE
)

Arguments

by

character(1). Grouping: "state" (default), "region", or "national".

component

character vector of components to sum. Default = all five.

financial_year

character vector to filter. NULL = all.

exclude_other

logical. Exclude non-state rows. Default TRUE.

Value

A data.table sorted by financial_year.

Examples

gst_annual_summary(by = "state", financial_year = "2023-24")[order(-total)][1:5]
#>    financial_year       state region      cgst      sgst       igst      cess
#>            <char>      <char> <char>     <num>     <num>      <num>     <num>
#> 1:        2023-24              Other 751420.86 942390.04 2053579.84 289107.66
#> 2:        2023-24 Maharashtra   West  86257.70 100843.35  109787.05  23228.74
#> 3:        2023-24   Karnataka  South  33321.41  40969.44   54123.33  16851.71
#> 4:        2023-24     Gujarat   West  34753.23  42370.54   40019.97   8024.63
#> 5:        2023-24  Tamil Nadu  South  31693.04  41082.07   39807.17   8746.83
#>        total
#>        <num>

#> 2:  320116.8
